events.reason: A held-scale location enclosure used the held scale as its accuracy unit, and subnormal scale round trips could lose coefficient accuracy despite a small score.
events.resolution: Normalize location by enclosed empirical spread; require logarithmic round-trip accuracy for physical scales and standard-deviation transport. Evaluate fixed standardized points directly when the ordinary scale becomes nonnormal. Added C++ and standalone regressions; reran all required suites. Enclosed initial location endpoints and reevaluated transported held-sd diagnostic likelihoods before the final frozen-source run.

events.reason: The initial held-subset implementation refused every free-shape held profile lacking a global certificate, unlike other partial families.
events.resolution: Restored the previous numerical shape/location/scale searches and face comparisons for location-held, scale-held and location-plus-scale-held subsets. Kept all new certificates, including the sufficient held-scale lst Cauchy route. Search convergence/failure checks remain; successful numerical estimates have no new globality claim. Restored golden-fit and lower-face test expectations and added exhaustion checks. Native final validation is final-simbox-10.log.gz; no-long-double is rerun on the workstation.
